title: introduce-cost-scribe-routing-and-latency-aware-quant-suggester
author: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Customers with mixed latency/cost SLOs often leave batching/caching/quantization defaults untouched. That produces suboptimal unit economics for tail workloads and bursty patterns. Motivation: introduce a lightweight routing and suggestion layer (Cost Scribe) that records per-route micro-econ signal, uses a latency-aware quantization suggester to create conservative quant profiles, and surfaces safe defaults in the Console so product engineers can opt-in without manual experimentation. This PR wires three pieces: 1) A routing heuristic that tags requests with a cost_economy score (serving/router/cost_scribe_router.go). The score is computed from token length histogram, recent latency percentiles, and prefill hit rate. 2) A latency-aware quantization suggester prototype (serving/quant/latency_aware_suggester.py) that produces quant profiles (bits/activation scale) with a safety margin tuned to measured tail latencies. 3) Minimal Console UI and docs to show suggested defaults and an opt-in toggle (console/ui/cost-suggestions.md, docs/notes/cost-scribe-rollout.md). Changes are non-breaking; defaults remain unchanged unless the user explicitly applies suggestions. Rollout plan: feature gated under FF_COST_SCRIBE. Start with a 5% shadow routing rollout to collect signals (no active rewrites), then escalate to suggestion-only UI, then automated apply for enterprise Dedicated tenants after manual review. Migration notes: new metrics (cost_scribe_score, suggested_quant_profile) require a short migration of our metrics ingestion; infra config file included. Tests: added unit tests around scoring heuristics and an e2e smoke test to validate the suggestion pipeline. Checklist: - [x] scoring heuristic implemented - [x] quant suggester prototype - [x] tests added - [x] console docs - [x] telemetry config - [x] FF gate added
commit_summary: 3 commits: initial cost_scribe router and scoring logic; latency-aware quant suggester prototype and test harness; console docs + telemetry config. High-level changeset focuses on hooking scorer into routing flow and emitting telemetry for later autotune runs.

A few asks: (1) please add a short comment on expected computational overhead of the scorer per request, (2) ensure scorer is no-op when FF is off, (3) add a small table in the doc showing example suggested profiles for short/medium/long sequences.
Ava Chen (2026-02-12): Addressed in commit 2. Scorer cost is ~0.2 micros per request (cached histogram lookups); added explicit no-op path and appended example table to console docs.

Liam O'Connor (2026-02-20): CI flaky on perf smoke once; reran and all green. Left a minor comment about log level noise in router, but not blocking.

release_notes: Add Cost Scribe: route-level micro-economics scorer and a latency-aware quantization suggester. Telemetry metrics emitted (cost_scribe_score, suggested_quant_profile). Feature gated and opt-in via Console. Non-breaking; no default changes until users accept suggestions.
